Which? not tried. Regions: South Asia (Sulekha, Ratnam, Andhra ebonite makers, Gama, Ranga, Kanwrite, Nataraj, Godrej), Latin America (Birome, Tilibra), SE Asia (Thien Long), Sub-Saharan Africa (Lucky Stationery Nigeria; Kenyan Business Daily page paywalled), North Africa (Ragab Papyrus Institute), Central Asia (Meros Samarkand paper), Middle East (Dezful qalam reeds and Istanbul tools as maker-less regions; Adel listed), Eastern Europe (Krasin, Logarex, Reiss), Oceania (Spirax).
